This early summer, Apple has been hit by the global memory crisis and raised prices significantly. For example, the iPad Air went from $599 to $749, the M5 MacBook Pro from $1,699 to $1,999, and the Apple TV from $129 to $199. The above are just some examples—the point is that these increases are quite staggering.

This situation inevitably raises the question—will Apple significantly improve its products under the new pricing to make them more attractive?

Of course, some Apple products are about to undergo major revisions, with the MacBook Pro and iPad mini being two of them. But for products that won't see major updates in the short term, I really can't imagine Apple selling yesterday's specifications at much higher prices and still making consumers feel they're getting value for money—especially when compared with what's available on the second-hand market right now.

If you could buy an M4 iPad Air a few months ago for $599 (or even as low as $499), why would you pay $749 now? The higher the price, the more obvious this question becomes.

Some Apple products have gone without major changes for a long time. The iPad Air has used the same design and features since 2020, with only chip upgrades and Apple Pencil Pro support; the basic iPad has been largely unchanged since 2022; and the iMac has been more or less the same since 2021.

Do these products need a redesign? Probably not, actually. But I think Apple could do something to make them more appealing at current price points. For example, the iMac could switch to a miniLED display, the iPad Air could get a 120Hz refresh rate, or the basic iPad could get a fully laminated display.

Compared with the price increases, these upgrades would cost relatively little and should also make consumers more accepting of the new pricing. On the other hand, Apple may also lower some product specifications to offset rising costs—for example, the iPhone may once again offer a 128GB version.

去年9月Apple發布iPhone 17時,新一代旗艦機何時打破15年前創下的紀錄,倒計時正式開始。這個紀錄要超過一年才能被打破,但根據目前的傳聞,iPhone 17將率先奪冠。

iPhone 4的銷售週期異常漫長

這項紀錄屬於iPhone 4,該機於2010年6月開售,直至2011年10月仍是Apple的頂級iPhone。由於Apple當年將旗艦機的發布週期由夏季改為秋季,iPhone 4穩坐皇座接近16個月。

對於打算「等iPhone 5」的消費者而言,那是一段特別令人沮喪的日子。Apple最終推出的是iPhone 4S,外形與iPhone 4幾乎一模一樣,改動都在內部:Siri首次登場、相機升級、效能亦有所提升。

iPhone 4技術上也經歷了多次發售階段。AT&T是iPhone在美國的獨家網絡商,率先開售;六個月後Verizon加入,成為美國第二間iPhone網絡商;其後歷經10個月波折,備受期待的白色機款終於面世。

自此之後,沒有任何一部iPhone能夠打破iPhone 4所保持的15個月旗艦機銷售紀錄。最接近的是iPhone 11 Pro,由於iPhone 12因疫情延期發布,它在市場上維持了13個月。其他例外情況也存在,例如iPhone SE到SE 2、再到iPhone 16e之間的間隔,每次都長達四年以上,但這些屬於刻意安排,並非旗艦機週期。

iPhone 17勢將打破紀錄(但情況有別)

預計iPhone 18要到2027年春季才會面世,這意味著iPhone 17將在Apple主力產品線頂端佔據約18個月,超越iPhone 4的紀錄,成為歷來標準版iPhone銷售週期最長的新基準。

iPhone 4年代與今日的一個關鍵分別,在於當時尚未設有Pro產品線。iPhone 4到iPhone 4S之間的漫長等待,對渴望新驚喜的消費者而言,是一次升級乾旱期。

最短的iPhone週期

順帶一提,iPhone升級之間相隔最短的時間可能會令人意外。令人想起的會是iPhone 12到iPhone 13的週期,由於Apple在疫情延期後調整了發布時間,該週期僅維持了11個月。

Local weather is one of the most underrated variables in Apple Home smart home automation setups. Over the past few years, I have used various sensors, from dripping faucets on freezing days to using Eve Aqua to adjust sprinkler schedules on hot days, and have applied them all. Eve Weather has been part of my setup for a while, and since it upgraded to support Matter a few years ago, it has been really useful at home.

HomeKit Weekly is a专题 series that focuses on smart home accessories, automation tips and tricks, and everything related to the Apple smart home framework.

If you have been following HomeKit Weekly, you know I like automation designs that run on their own. Smart home accessories are only truly useful when they can execute tasks automatically. That is why I always recommend building your smart home around a single ecosystem rather than mixing and matching. Even though we are in the Matter era, I still don't want to use a bunch of different platforms. For me, the answer is Apple Home. I prefer Eve devices because they have always placed a strong emphasis on privacy, and as long as you stick with local control combined with Matter, you don't need to sign up for any extra cloud accounts. Eve has also been very active in supporting Matter and Thread in recent years. These are exactly the kind of developments you want to see.

Eve Weather is a compact device that gives you three data points: temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure. It has an IPX4 waterproof rating, and its aluminum casing design fits in perfectly when placed outdoors. My unit is installed right outside. What it provides are readings that are very close to the actual conditions on the ground, and they often differ from Apple Weather data by several degrees. Honestly, that few degrees difference can be critical in extreme heat or severe cold. When your home's water pipes freeze at 31 degrees Fahrenheit, but your app shows it is still 34 degrees, you will be glad you installed this local sensor.

One of the underrated features of Eve Weather is its built-in 12-hour weather trend display. It uses barometric pressure changes to forecast weather trends, showing icons for expected sunny, cloudy, rainy, or stormy conditions. This small detail is very practical, letting you see at a glance without having to open a phone app.

Here are a few examples of automations you can set up using Eve Weather:

  • When the temperature drops below freezing, turn on a colored light to remind people at home to let the faucets drip.
  • When outdoor humidity is particularly high, turn on the dehumidifier.
  • If it has already rained and the forecast shows more rain, delay activating the sprinkler system.
  • Without leaving the house, ask Siri how many degrees it is in the front yard right now.

Matter and Thread support in 2026

A few years ago, Eve released a free firmware update that added Matter support to Eve Weather. If you already own this device, you can upgrade through the Eve app. The Matter version supports Amazon Alexa, Google Home, and SmartThings in addition to Apple Home. The sensor itself is exactly the same; it just becomes cross-platform compatible, so you won't have to worry about switching your main smart home ecosystem in the future.

Eve Weather is a so-called 'Minimal Thread Device'. This means it can communicate via Thread, but it does not relay data. That task is left to always-on 'Full Thread Devices' such as Eve Energy or Eve Water Guard. The more Full Thread Devices you have in your home, the more stable the Thread network will be, and battery-powered devices like Eve Weather will directly benefit from this stability.

You still don't need an Eve account. Unless you actively choose to, all data stays local. The Eve iPhone app is a great tool for visualizing historical trends in temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity. Using it to analyze patterns and make smarter decisions about when to water the lawn or manage electricity usage is quite interesting.

I have several HomePod minis placed throughout my home, and I rely on my home's Eero 6E network to support Thread. Eero has built-in Thread support, providing a stable connection foundation for accessories like Eve Weather and ensuring smooth operation.

Summary after using Eve Weather

The only thing I still hope to see improved is switching to a rechargeable battery. Although the current battery life can last several months, I would prefer it to come with a USB-C port like the Eve Room. Apart from that, Eve Weather is definitely one of my favorite Apple Home accessories. The design is simple and looks great, and thanks to Matter, it works well across all major platforms. If you want to add local weather information to your smart home and pair it with practical automations, Eve Weather is, for me, an unequivocal recommendation.

You can buy it directly from Amazon or the Eve official online store.

47 人案 45 名被告串謀顛覆國家政權罪成，當中 12 名被告提出上訴，今年 2 月被上訴庭駁回，其中 11 人再向高院上訴庭申請，上訴至終審法院的許可證明書。上訴庭今（10日）頒下決定，同意涉案法律論點具重大而廣泛重要性，考慮到是終審法院首次就相關法律議題作裁決，批准 11 人向終審法院上訴。

47人案中，12 名被告就定罪和判刑提出上訴，在今年 2 月被駁回；其中 11 人再提出上訴至終審法院，今獲上訴庭批准。（資料相片）

上訴人為楊雪盈、黃碧雲、鄒家成、余慧明、何桂藍、林卓廷、吳政亨、鄭達鴻、何啟明、陳志全、梁國雄。申請由首席法官潘兆初、上訴庭法官彭偉昌及法官譚耀豪處理。

上訴庭今年 2 月頒下判詞，認為正確詮釋下，《國安法》22 條下的「其他非法手段」，不限於「使用武力或威脅使用武力」及刑事行為；又審視特區憲制秩序、立法會憲制職能及議員維護《基本法》的責任，認為涉案謀劃旨在迫中央政府結束一國兩制，顛覆憲制秩序，屬非法手段，而涉案連串行為屬被禁行為、立法會不干預原則不適用，被告意圖觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制及其後果，具有特定顛覆意圖。至於《基本法》是否容許議員透過否決預算案逼特首問責，上訴庭指具重大憲制意義，但各方陳詞「流於表面」而不作定論。

上訴庭：部分論點未顧及事實背景及法庭裁決

上訴庭今歸納上訴方提出的 5 個議題，包括《國安法》22 條下「其他非法手段」的正確詮釋為何；觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制是否構成「其他非法手段」；立法會議員的憲制責任、權力及職能是什麼，及涉案「連串行為」是否「受禁行為」；立法會不干預原則是否適用；及意圖觸發《基本法》50 至 52 條機制，是否構成顛覆政權的特定意圖。上訴庭指，上述論點顯然與上訴理據大幅相似，但部分似乎未有充分顧及本案的事實背景及法庭裁決。

上訴庭指，考慮雙方書面陳詞後，認為判決所涉的主要議題，具有重大而廣泛重要性，當中涉及《國安法》第 22 條的控罪元素，包括犯罪行為及犯罪意圖；以及立法會議員履行憲制職能的責任，特別是關於審核財政預算案及啟動《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制的事宜。上訴庭指，相關爭議值得終審法院考慮，尤其這是終審法院首次就相關事宜作出裁決。

就五項法律議題批終極上訴許可證明書

上訴庭遂就以下 5 個議題，批出上訴至終審法院的許可證明書，包括按照國安法 22 條，何謂「其他非法手段」，是否只局限於「使用武力或威脅使用武力」或刑事行為；涉案的「謀劃」或「連串行為」是否條文所指的「非法手段」及「被禁行為」；立法會不干預原則是否適用；以及被告意圖觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條所訂機制及其帶來的後果，是否懷有特定的顛覆意圖。

47 人案中，45 名被告串謀顛覆國家政權罪成，其中 12 人包括楊雪盈、黃碧雲、鄒家成、余慧明、何桂藍、林卓廷、吳政亨、鄭達鴻、何啟明、陳志全、梁國雄、黃子悅早前提出上訴，在今年 2 月下旬被全數駁回；律政司就劉偉聰脫罪的上訴亦同被駁回。除黃子悅外，其餘 11 名被告再申請上訴至終審法院，向上訴庭申請上訴許可證明書。而律政司則至限期屆滿前，未有對劉偉聰的無罪裁決提出上訴。

酷熱天氣警告生效五日

天文台表示，受帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，今、明兩日，本港極端酷熱，部分地區氣温達 37 度或以上。酷熱天氣警告自 8 月 5 日生效至今，今早七時，天文台氣温 30.3 度。勞工處自 2023 年以來，發出最少 205 次暑熱工作警告，今早發出的，同樣是最低級別的黃色暑熱工作警告。

「香港暑熱指數」VS 「濕球黑球溫度指數」

無論氣温如何破紀錄，都只發黃色警告，為何從末見「紅」、「黑」？勞工處發警告，是根據「香港暑熱指數」作決定，指數由天文台和中大醫學院研究，基於「濕球黑球溫度指數」發展出來，包含環境溫度、濕度、空氣流動及太陽熱輻射水平等數據，及整體入院數字作考量。

林超英：市民大部份時間在室內活動

不過，前天文台台長林超英指，「香港暑熱指數」針對大眾設計的，市民大部份時間在室內活動，指數內太陽曝曬的份量很少，不適用於露天工作處境。他認為應採用國際通用的「濕球黑球溫度」作參數，才能涵蓋太陽曝露對人體加熱的因素。

工權會：曾因濕度高，也發出了警告

工業傷亡權益會總幹事蕭倩文指，數位前天文台台長都認同「濕球黑球指數」。她又引述

樂施會去年公布的數據指，若以「濕球黑球指數」計算，去年有數天達紅色警告級別，但勞工處採用的「香港暑熱指數」，則一天也沒有。

建議採用「雙軌制」

但「香港暑熱指數」也非沒反映現實，蕭倩文指指，曾有一天，温度只有 30 度，但濕度高，也發出了黃色暑熱警告。「這種情況下，此機制又似乎比濕球黑球領先。」她建議採用「雙軌」，甚至「多軌制」。「哪一個數字更快地達到發出黃、紅、黑的警告，就先用那一個。這樣，大家就無需不斷地爭拗用哪一個做指標了。」

清潔工手推車辣手

清潔工穿上勞工手套，每架手推車推把上又包上一層黑色垃圾袋，只為將手把儘量降溫。「你留意吓有無人唔戴手套？」清潔工李生說，上水一帶少樹蔭，對於工友而言，工作期間手推車手把相當辣手，「如果唔帶手套，成隻辣到彈起，（手套）一定有用！ 100%有用！熱到直到頭好似被火燒過嗰啲鐵咁，戴咗手套就冇事！」

飲足四枝水 避開正午工作

iPhone 18 Pro 零件成本將增加 38%

生產一部新裝置的成本大致可分為三部分：零件、組裝及間接費用。最後一類涵蓋範圍甚廣，由新裝置的研發以至市場推廣活動的開支皆計算在內。

TrendForce 的報告特別聚焦於第一項，亦即所謂的物料清單（BOM）成本。

報告指出，去年記憶體佔 iPhone 零件成本約 10%，預計到明年將超過 40%。

這是一個急劇的轉變。去年，螢幕還是 iPhone 內最昂貴的零件；今年，這個位置將會由記憶體取代。

但 Apple 可能會自行消化部分成本

TrendForce 亦持相同觀點，並以 Apple MacBook 的加價為例。儘管加幅已算驚人，但仍未完全反映 Apple 製造成本的上漲。

林超英重申應使用濕球、黑球温度指標，他憶述，當年有關的公式，接近定好，天文台曾準備向香港公開這項數據，但受到「某部門」反對，有些擔憂公布濕球、黑球温度引起，會勞工界注意，所以要求天文台另制一個不適用於露天情況的指標出來，這就是今天政府引用的「香港暑熱指數」。

[0] A Bloomberg report yesterday suggested that the future Apple Watch lineup could see some pretty significant changes.

[1] The report specifically mentions that Apple is exploring models with a round face rather than the square one.

[2] Most smartwatches are round

[3] While square-faced watches have existed for over a century, traditional watches are predominantly round, and Android smartwatches are no different. Examples include:

  • [4] Amazfit Active Max
  • [5] Samsung Galaxy Watch 9
  • [6] Motorola Moto Watch
  • [7] All Garmin models (Venu, Epix Pro, Forerunner, Fenix)
  • [8] Google Pixel Watch

[9] Apple has always chosen a rectangular design, which makes it the outlier, so it wouldn't be surprising for the company to consider releasing a round Apple Watch in the future.

[10] There are also arguments for a round Apple Watch

[11] Apple's reasoning for choosing a rectangular design is that it can display more information. All the other screens we use daily — phones, tablets, laptops, monitors, and so on — are rectangular, and this is certainly no coincidence.

[12] Ultimately, this choice comes down to aesthetics versus practicality. Some people will always put practicality first, so the rectangular Apple Watch is definitely not going away. But on the other hand, there are also those who care deeply about appearance, and many people have a strong preference for round watches — whether traditional or smart.

[13] Additionally, not everyone who wears an Apple Watch needs to view a lot of information on the screen. Even if you rarely look at the screen, there are plenty of reasons to wear an Apple Watch, such as:

  • [14] Health and fitness monitoring
  • [15] Sleep tracking
  • [16] Emergency features like fall detection
  • [17] Contactless payments

[18] Of these, health and fitness monitoring is the biggest selling point for many people. If you're mainly not using your Apple Watch to view content, a round screen really isn't an issue for you at all.

[19] But the case for an Apple Ring is even stronger

[20] However, if you're the type of person who mainly uses an Apple Watch for health and fitness monitoring and doesn't really use it to view information, I'd say a smart ring is a much smarter choice.

[21] I personally switched from an Apple Watch to an Oura smart ring back in 2024, and recently upgraded to the fifth generation. What I love about it is that it's very discreet, allows me to keep wearing my favourite traditional watch, and only needs charging once a week.

[22] Almost two years ago, I already said I fully support replacing the Apple Watch with a smart ring, and I also believe Apple should release such a product. To this day, I still firmly believe in this view, and Gurman's report says Eddy Cue is also a huge fan of smart rings, so it looks like the chances of it happening are pretty good.

[23] I think it's possible Apple will release a round Apple Watch, but I lean more towards the idea that an Apple Ring will come first. What do you think? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.

iPhone 用戶介面其中一個最令人煩惱嘅元素，就係我哋要玩估吓吓嘅遊戲，先至可以更改一個應用程式嘅設定。

我哋都試過呢個情況。我哋想更改一個應用程式嘅設定，於是就去到「漢堡選單」，揀選「設定」再搵我哋想要嗰個。結果搵唔到，先至發覺需要退出個 App、打開 Apple 自己嘅「設定」App、搜尋嗰個應用程式、再去嗰度更改，最後先可以重新打開本來想用嘅 App。

呢個過程本身已經好笨重，而最差嘅係，我哋仲要先估一估到底應該去邊度搑，搞到成件事更加麻煩。

以 Apple 自己嘅「相機」App 為例。最近嘅 iPhone 為 1x 鏡頭提供咗 Apple 所稱嘅 Fusion Camera。佢嘅預設焦距係 24mm，但我哋其實可以將預設改做 28mm 或者 35mm。做法就係由個 App 自動裁剪影像。除此之外，我哋仲可以選擇係咪要撳一下「1x」嘅按鈕，去循環切換唔同嘅焦距。

但除非係收藏咗喺我未發現嘅地方，否則我哋根本唔能夠喺「相機」App 內部做呢個設定。我哋反而要打開「設定」App、向下捲去「相機」*，再向下捲去「相片拍攝」嗰一節，撳一下「Fusion Camera」——做完呢啲步驟，先至可以揀我哋想要嘅選項。

*仲未講到我哋仲要估吓一個 Apple App 到底會喺「設定」入面有自己嘅一節，定係會擺喺「App」嗰一節入面……

一個捷徑提供咗部分嘅解決方法

我哋無法避免估吓吓嘅部分，但起碼有一個由 Snazzy Labs 嘅 Quinn Nelson 製作嘅實用第三方捷徑，可以減輕少少痛苦。

多謝 John Gruber 畀呢個我。多謝你。如果你都想自己安裝嘅話：

  • 喺呢度下載並安裝
  • 打開控制中心
  • 撳左上角嘅 + 號
  • 喺底部撳「加入控制項目」
  • 搜尋「捷徑」
  • 撳「執行捷徑」

安裝完成之後，如果你用緊一個 App 時發現要去獨立嘅「設定」App 嗰度搵設定，只需要由右上角向下滑打開控制中心，再撳一下 App 設定嘅按鈕就得。

不過，我更加希望見到一個徹底嘅解決方法，而唔係一個實用嘅第三方變通方案。

我嘅建議係，每個應用程式嘅設定選單底部都應該有一個「更多」嘅選項——然後自動打開「設定」App，並跳去正確嘅頁面。咁樣的話，如果我哋喺 App 自己嘅設定選單入面搵唔到，所需嘅操作都只係多撳一下。

已退休的大律師吳靄儀，在 8.18 流水式集會案涉參與未經批准集結罪成，判監 9 個月、緩刑兩年，被大律師公會投訴專業失當，大律師紀律審裁組今年 6 月以大比數裁定投訴不成立。大律師公會執委會上周五（7 日）提司法覆核，要求法庭推翻判決、宣告投訴成立，並下令審裁組向吳發信訓誡、或發還由其他人組成的審裁組重新考慮。 大律師公會指，審裁組指吳靄儀的行為不應受道德譴責亦並非可恥，是與原審裁決抵觸、對刑事法庭的附帶攻擊，又強調吳的行為向公眾發放錯誤訊息，在政治動盪時期，大律師也可接受公然漠視法律的行為，為港人樹立壞榜樣。《集誌社》就事件向吳靄儀查詢，她以短訊回覆指 「不予置評」（no comments） 。

2021 年，吳靄儀被裁在 8.18 流水式集會案，參與未經批准集結罪成。（資料相片）

專業失當投訴不成立

申請人為大律師公會執行委員會，擬答辯人為由資深大律師郭莎樂、大律師趙芷筠及施麗珊組成的大律師紀律審裁組，利害關係方為吳靄儀。

根據入稟狀，吳靄儀自 1988 年成為大律師，執業至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，在 8.18 流水式集會案被裁明知而參與未經批准集結罪成，判監 9 個月、緩刑兩年。大律師公會指吳的行為可能損害大律師聲譽，或削弱公眾對大律師專業的信心，違反《行為守則》，但大律師紀律審裁組今年 6 月 8 日，以大比數裁定該投訴不成立。

申請方：審裁組裁決與原審抵觸

入稟狀指，審裁組裁定投訴不成立，是根本上出錯，大律師公會為履行監管職責及促進公眾信心提出司法覆核。申請方引原審法官指，眾被告蓄意藐視法律、以「疏散人群」的虛假藉口繞過禁令，有預謀挑戰警方權威、法律及秩序，在動盪時期刻意違法及挑戰公共秩序，認為涉案罪行嚴重及不可接受，尤其當行為是由被公眾期望尊重和維護法治的大律師所干犯。

申請方續指，審裁組錯誤自我引導及誤解法律原則，未有集中考慮吳有否違反大律師公會的《行為守則》，而是抽象考慮有否「專業失當」；而審裁組裁定吳的犯罪行為不應受道德譴責亦並非可恥，是與原審裁決相抵觸、對刑事法庭裁決不被允許的「附帶攻擊」（collateral attack）。

Rumors have long pointed to Apple preparing an all-glass new iPhone design for the 20th anniversary of the iPhone next year. But an analyst at Jefferies believes that device is no longer moving forward.

Wall Street Analyst Says iPhone 20th Anniversary Bold Redesign Has Been Cancelled

Wall Street investment bank Jefferies downgraded Apple stock to "Underperform" today, with analyst Edison Lee (李) noting that the potential cancellation of the 20th anniversary iPhone redesign is one of the main reasons.

The key to this downgrade lies in the suspected cancellation of Apple's all-glass iPhone. Although the project was reported to be in development as early as 2025, with rumors suggesting a launch as soon as 2027, Apple has never commented on the speculation. However, Apple quietly filed a patent application for a "six-sided glass enclosure" back in 2019. Jefferies had previously believed that launching an all-glass iPhone was possible, but Lee thinks development work has stalled. According to the analyst, supply chain checks show the project was cancelled due to excessively low yield rates. Lee considers this decision "a major setback in driving higher-priced iPhone launches amid surging memory prices." If the device were to launch in September 2027 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, he estimates the blended retail price would reach US$2,060, higher than the average selling price of any model in history. Lee wrote: "More importantly, we believe the original plan was to extend the all-glass design to future iPhone Pro and Pro Max models, further raising their average selling prices and profits." He believes that amid rising memory prices, this move would have been a key defensive strategy.

Lee also pointed to Apple's AI strategy and rising component costs for the iPhone 19 Pro as reasons for the further downgrade of the company's stock.

From Lee's report, it is unclear whether the analyst believes the entire redesign has been shelved, or only certain elements of it have been cancelled.

Top comment posted by Currentinterest

These analysts have been wrong many times in their predictions about Apple's future plans. Even the term "all-glass" may never have accurately reflected what Apple truly wanted to do. The 20th anniversary phone will be innovative, and there will be market demand for it, regardless of the final design.

For example, rumors have long suggested that Apple will not be able to completely remove the Dynamic Island cutout next year. As a result, an "all-glass" display is simply impossible. However, the rumored four-curved-edge design might still launch.

In any case, if the Apple iPhone 20th anniversary design really has been cancelled, we should get confirmation from other credible sources very soon.

林超英：香港暑熱指數沒處理露天太陽曬

林超英指，香港暑熱指數避開了露天工作情況，沒處理露天太陽曬的情況。他指出，所有的數個，都是用三組數字，分別為氣温、黑球、濕球温度，只是比重不同。

勞工處回覆查詢指，氣溫只是熱壓力的其中一項風險因素，其他因素還有濕度、風速和太陽照射等，處方提倡使用「香港暑熱指數」制定的工作暑熱警告，「不是單以氣溫」評估熱壓力風險。

勞工處：增加了濕度參數比重

勞工處指，「香港暑熱指數」計算的方程式，考慮因素基本與「濕球黑球溫度指數」相同。兩者的分別是，有關環境溫度、濕度、空氣流動及太陽熱輻射水平等因素的加權比例「稍有分別」，「香港暑熱指數」因應本港夏季較潮濕，增加了濕度參數比重。

勞工處又指本地學者分析了「香港暑熱指數」與急症室非意外入院數據，發現當「香港暑熱指數」達約30或以上時，市民需住院風險明顯增加。勞工處認為，「香港暑熱指數」適用於全港性的工作暑熱警告系統。

勞工處指，制定工作暑熱警告臨界值時，以工人在不同情況下工作，都不會令身體核心溫度上升至超過攝氏38度為大原則。因為，當身體核心溫度超過 38 度，就可能會顯著增加中暑的風險。勞工處表示，會密切留意暑熱天氣以及「工作暑熱警告」系統的運作情況，檢視系統是否需要再作進一步優化。

二〇二〇年，馬爾登大部分地區在山火中付諸一炬，包括消防局、郵局、市政廳及圖書館。

美國國家運輸安全委員會正調查墜機原因。

Apple 正在開發全新的「參考圖片」（Reference Image）功能

雖然合成圖像試圖冒充真實的問題並非新鮮事，但隨著生成式 AI 圖像的興起，情況已變得越來越迫切。

以往一個熟練的修圖師需要幾個小時甚至幾日才能做到的事情，現在只需幾秒鐘，靠的只不過是一個未成形的意念配上一句簡短提示。

為了解決這個問題，已經有不少公司推出方法，令 AI 生成內容更容易被識別。例如 Google 開發了 SynthID，此技術可將肉眼看不到的水印嵌入 AI 生成的圖像及其他媒體。該技術其後已擴展至 Google 以外的產品，包括 OpenAI 等公司亦採用它來標記生成的圖像。

與此同時，Meta 亦在 Facebook、Instagram 和 Threads 為 AI 生成的內容加入標籤，不過這類系統在可靠識別被篡改媒體方面仍然有局限，即使是由該公司自家 AI 模型所製作的內容亦一樣。

如今看來，Apple 可能亦準備加入這場戰局，除了會「標記」透過 Image Playground 製作的圖片外，iOS 27 beta 5 的新代碼顯示，Apple 正在開發一項名為「Apple 參考圖片」（Apple Reference Image）的功能，利用與 iPhone 相機硬件綁定的獨特數據，認證相片的來源。

配合 Apple 一貫以私隱為先的方針處理雲端上的敏感用戶數據，Apple 在設計 Apple 參考圖片時，會確保 Apple 本身無法讀取原始相片。

系統會將相片傳送到 Private Cloud Compute 進行認證，同時只將部分感光元件資訊和相片元數據回傳給 Apple。有趣的是，如果 Apple 判定某個感光元件可能已被入侵，它可能會撤銷與該元件相關的先前認證。

目前此功能預設為關閉，正式推出後，用戶可透過「設定 > 相機 > 參考圖片」，然後點擊「參考模式」（Reference Mode）來啟用。

很重要的一點是，參考模式必須在用相機全新的「參考」模式拍攝時一併使用。即是說，正常拍攝的相片不會包含日後用作認證的出處資訊。

參考模式本身似乎不會自動認證相片。用戶可以之後才選擇進行認證，到時原始圖像和相關的出處數據會一併傳送到 Private Cloud Compute 進行核實。認證期間，Apple 會為該張相片編配一個獨特的 ID。

這個系統另一個注重私隱的地方是，已認證的相片可分享給其他人，對方的 Apple 裝置可在本地檢查該張相片是否仍然處於已認證狀態，而無須將他們正在查看的圖片資料告知 Apple。

分享時所包含的資訊可能會因應分享方式（AirDrop、Messages 等）以及相片屬於原版、編輯版還是已認證版本而有所不同。值得留意的是，如果用戶選擇分享「所有相片數據」，Apple 表示傳送過程中可能會包括獨特的硬件識別碼，以及與該圖片相關的未經裁剪原片。

Apple 同時亦為 USB 傳輸加入了「連同出處資料一併傳送」（Transfer with Provenance）選項。啟用後，傳送至 Mac 或 PC 的已認證相片會包含其參考圖片數據；而未經認證的相片亦可能會附帶出處資訊，例如獨特的硬件識別碼和任何未經裁剪的原片。

Yelp 表示：

Apple 已同意支付 15 萬美元，就美國平等就業機會委員會（EEOC）去年提出的宗教歧視訴訟達成和解。以下是詳細內容。

Apple 就宗教歧視訴訟達成和解

去年 9 月，EEOC 向 Apple 提出訴訟，指控該公司解僱了一名維吉尼亞州 Apple Store 員工，原因涉及宗教歧視，以及對該員工投訴宗教歧視作出報復。

EEOC 在訴訟中聲稱，儘管該員工一直獲得正面的工作表現評核，但他在皈依猶太教並要求調動工作時間，以便「因遵守安息日而不於星期五及星期六上班」後遭到解僱。

Apple 從未就案件公開置評，而法庭文件顯示公司否認有不當行為。然而，路透社今日報道，Apple 現在已同意支付 15 萬美元以和解有關指控。

節錄自和解同意令（經由 Law360 取得）：

在本法令生效日期起計三十（30）日內，被告須向 Tyler Steele 支付合共 15 萬美元，款項及形式如下：a. 其中一筆款項為 8 萬美元，屬於補發工資。此款項將歸類為工資，並須扣除預扣稅及繳納薪酬稅。被告就 FICA 等須承擔的僱主稅項及法定僱主供款屬獨立計算，不得從補發工資款項中扣除。被告須透過 IRS W-2 表格向 Steele 先生及國稅局申報該筆補發工資款項，金額為已扣除所有法定稅項及預扣稅後的淨額。b. 第二筆款項為 7 萬美元，屬於補償性損害賠償及利息。Steele 先生須向被告提供 W9 表格，被告方有責任處理此筆款項。此款項將歸類為非工資性質的損害賠償，毋須預扣稅項，並以一筆過方式支付。被告須透過 IRS 1099-MISC 表格向 Steele 先生及國稅局申報此筆非工資款項。

根據和解條款，Apple 同意（除其他事項外）為北維吉尼亞相關零售市場的特定員工提供宗教歧視及宗教便利安排規定的培訓，並在為期兩年的同意令期間，向 EEOC 報告被拒絕的宗教便利安排申請及宗教歧視投訴。

最後，同意令註明，和解並不構成 Apple 承認有違法行為，並明確指出「Apple 否認這些指控，但同意透過和解方式解決訴訟」。
